desc:
🏨 Welcome to Build Your Hotel!

You inherited your grandfather's old hotel... now it's up to YOU to bring it back to life and turn it into a 5-STAR destination! ⭐

🧹 Restore and rebuild your hotel
🛏️ Build & customize unique guest rooms
👨‍👩‍👧 Welcome tourists, couples, families & VIP guests
👷 Hire staff and automate your hotel
⭐ Earn reviews and improve your Hotel Class
🪴 Decorate rooms, lobbies & common areas
☕ Build amenities and offer better service
🏗️ Expand your property and grow even bigger
📋 Complete goals, contracts & milestones
🎉 Handle special events and huge groups of guests
💎 Collect Gems and unlock exclusive hotel styles

Can you finish what your grandfather started and build a 5-STAR hotel? 🏨✨
